description: The host's Claude and Codex subscription accounts (hostaccounts): list them; add one (Claude: name and an existing signed-in config folder, or name and token where the host has no claude; Codex: name and an existing signed-in home); rename one (id, name); replace a token account's token (id, token); remove one (id); select a provider's default for new chats (provider, id; "" for the CLI's own sign-in); read a subscription's usage (id; "" for the CLI's own sign-in); sign in (sign_in: provider and name for a new account, or id to sign in to one again; Claude's runs claude auth login with the account's own folder, Codex's a device-code login; its lines come as they're written, the page to open among them, then its end; the connection's going stops it); pass a code the sign-in page showed to the sign-in this connection runs (code: no answer of its own). Each other is answered with accounts.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

provider.description: add, select, sign_in (a new account): whose.

id.description: rename, token, remove, select, usage, sign_in: the account ("" for the CLI's own sign-in, select and usage only).

name.description: add, rename, sign_in (a new account): its name.

token.description: add (Claude), token: a token from claude setup-token.

home.description: add (Codex): an existing CODEX_HOME on the host, signed in with ChatGPT and keeping its credentials in a file.

folder.description: add (Claude): an existing Claude config folder on the host, signed in (claude auth status says so, run with it).

code.description: code: what the sign-in page showed, pasted.
